# Aqua Tech Polymers

> Indian manufacturer of bonding adhesives, crepe paper tube adhesive (CPT)
> and cotton tape for transformer and electrical insulation manufacturers.
> The ATP series (ATP-3900B, ATP-120) supplies high-strength adhesives for
> power transformer insulation cylinders 8–10 feet long, positioned as a
> cost-effective Indian alternative to imported German adhesives, supplied
> to leading Indian manufacturers under annual supply contracts.

## Products
- [PBA Series (PBA 90R, PBA 93 MV, PBA 96MHV)](https://aquatechpolymers.com/products/pba-series): Bonding adhesive for distribution transformer manufacturing.
- [Crepe Paper Tube Adhesive (CPT)](https://aquatechpolymers.com/products/crepe-paper-tube-adhesive): Adhesive for crepe paper tube manufacturing in the transformer and electrical insulation industry.
- [ATP Series (ATP-3900B, ATP-120)](https://aquatechpolymers.com/products/atp-power-transformer-series): High-strength adhesive for power transformer insulation cylinders, 8–10 feet long.
- [Cotton Tape](https://aquatechpolymers.com/products/cotton-tape): For insulation, winding and binding in transformer manufacturing.

## Power Transformer Adhesives
- [High-strength adhesives for power transformers](https://aquatechpolymers.com/power-transformer-adhesives): The full ATP series story — an Indian alternative to imported adhesives.

## Applications
- [Distribution Transformers](https://aquatechpolymers.com/applications/distribution-transformers)
- [Power Transformers](https://aquatechpolymers.com/applications/power-transformers)

Also supplied for: Pre-Compressed Board, Press Board, Laminated Board, Insulation
Kraft Paper, Press Board Components, Dovetail Strips, Spacers, Electrical
Insulation Components.
